name: Lays the closing model expects to drift, closed at the SP
hypothesis: Where the closing model's expected BSP is longer than the best lay by at least 3% and the model's own price is no shorter than the lay, a lay closed by a back at the SP returns the drift.
mechanism: The mirror of the live rule: the morning book overrates horses the model and the closing model both expect to drift; the SP back closes the position at the market's own close.
workflow: none yet: replay through research/queries; paper and pilot workflows are phase 2

evidence.claim: the lay arm: +GBP827 over 21 days on GBP75,509 of liability (0.44%), 15 of 21 days up; at 10 or under +GBP772
the rule's parameters: 3% bar, lays at 20 or under, GBP400 at risk a horse, GBP4,000 a day, closed by a back at the BSP

limits.note: max_order is the rule's max_stake (trading/config_live.json); max_day_loss and max_market_exposure are the arm's GBP4,000 day liability (a lay's worst case is its liability), so they bind no earlier than the arm; max_day_turnover does not bind (the 1e6 of config_live.json's unused limits); the rate, collar and book age are the desk's choices, not from a test; max_book_age_s is the replay's 6-minute staleness (research/arms/core.py STALE)

gate.metric: daily result at the BSP close after the non-runners' reduction and 2% (research/arms/core.py score_side result_reduced)
